```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")

# Requires Chik_total created by the revised
# 01_data_import_cleaning.Rmd.
#
# Primary study period:
#   1 January 2016 – 31 December 2025
#
# Primary analytic definition:
#   confirmed chikungunya cases with
#   CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13)
```

## Purpose

The revised primary study period is 2016–2025.

The primary analytic dataset (`Chik_total`) is constructed in
`01_data_import_cleaning.Rmd` and contains confirmed chikungunya cases
defined by `CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13)`.

This file checks the relationship between final classification
(`CLASSI_FIN`) and confirmation criterion (`CRITERIO`) so that the
manuscript uses terminology consistent with the actual analytic
definition.

In particular, this analysis determines:

1. the exact analytic sample size for 2016–2025;
2. the distribution of `CRITERIO` among confirmed cases;
3. whether confirmed cases include both laboratory and
   clinical-epidemiological confirmation;
4. whether any confirmed cases have missing or otherwise uncategorized
   `CRITERIO` values.

No previously reported manuscript total is assumed to be correct.
All counts below are recalculated directly from the revised
2016–2025 analytic dataset.

## Confirm analytic period and sample

```{r analytic-sample-check}
stopifnot(exists("Chik_total"))

required_vars <- c("DT_SIN_PRI", "CLASSI_FIN", "CRITERIO")
missing_vars <- setdiff(required_vars, names(Chik_total))

if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required variables in Chik_total: ",
    paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Defensive restriction to the revised study period.
# This should not remove any observations if 01 was run correctly.
chik_check <- Chik_total %>%
  mutate(DT_SIN_PRI = as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI)) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(DT_SIN_PRI),
    DT_SIN_PRI >= as.Date("2016-01-01"),
    DT_SIN_PRI <= as.Date("2025-12-31")
  )

cat(
  "Study period:",
  format(min(chik_check$DT_SIN_PRI), "%Y-%m-%d"),
  "to",
  format(max(chik_check$DT_SIN_PRI), "%Y-%m-%d"),
  "\n"
)

cat("Rows in Chik_total:", nrow(Chik_total), "\n")
cat("Rows within 2016-2025:", nrow(chik_check), "\n")

if (nrow(chik_check) != nrow(Chik_total)) {
  warning(
    "Chik_total contains observations outside 2016-2025. ",
    "Check 01_data_import_cleaning.Rmd."
  )
}

confirmed_cases <- chik_check %>%
  filter(CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13))

cat(
  "Confirmed analytic N (CLASSI_FIN 1/13):",
  nrow(confirmed_cases),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(nrow(confirmed_cases) == nrow(chik_check))
```

## CLASSI_FIN distribution

```{r classi-fin-distribution}
cat("\nCLASSI_FIN distribution in the analytic dataset:\n")

classi_distribution <- chik_check %>%
  count(CLASSI_FIN, sort = TRUE)

print(as.data.frame(classi_distribution))

cat(
  "\nTotal:",
  sum(classi_distribution$n),
  "\n"
)
```

## CLASSI_FIN × CRITERIO cross-tabulation

```{r classi-fin-criterio-crosstab}
cat("\nCLASSI_FIN × CRITERIO cross-tabulation:\n")

crosstab <- chik_check %>%
  count(CLASSI_FIN, CRITERIO, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(CLASSI_FIN, CRITERIO)

print(as.data.frame(crosstab))

cat(
  "\nTotal rows represented in cross-tab:",
  sum(crosstab$n),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(sum(crosstab$n) == nrow(chik_check))
```

## CRITERIO distribution among confirmed cases

```{r confirmed-criterio}
criterio_confirmed <- confirmed_cases %>%
  count(CRITERIO, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n),
    percent = 100 * proportion
  ) %>%
  arrange(CRITERIO)

cat("\nCRITERIO distribution among confirmed cases:\n")

print(as.data.frame(criterio_confirmed))

cat(
  "\nTotal confirmed cases represented:",
  sum(criterio_confirmed$n),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  sum(criterio_confirmed$n) == nrow(confirmed_cases)
)
```

## Missing CRITERIO among confirmed cases

```{r missing-criterio}
n_criterio_missing <- confirmed_cases %>%
  summarise(n = sum(is.na(CRITERIO))) %>%
  pull(n)

pct_criterio_missing <-
  100 * n_criterio_missing / nrow(confirmed_cases)

cat(
  "Confirmed cases with missing CRITERIO:",
  n_criterio_missing,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Percent of confirmed cases with missing CRITERIO:",
  round(pct_criterio_missing, 4),
  "%\n"
)
```

## CRITERIO by year

This check determines whether the confirmation criterion changed
substantially over the revised 2016–2025 study period.

```{r criterio-by-year}
criterio_year <- confirmed_cases %>%
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(DT_SIN_PRI)) %>%
  count(year, CRITERIO, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    year_total = sum(n),
    percent = 100 * n / year_total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(year, CRITERIO)

print(as.data.frame(criterio_year))
```

## Final reconciliation

```{r final-reconciliation}
analytic_n <- nrow(confirmed_cases)

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("STEP 3 FINAL RECONCILIATION\n")
cat("========================================\n")

cat("Study period: 2016-01-01 to 2025-12-31\n")
cat("Analytic definition: CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13)\n")

cat(
  "Final confirmed analytic N:",
  format(analytic_n, big.mark = ","),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Confirmed cases with missing CRITERIO:",
  format(n_criterio_missing, big.mark = ","),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Percent with missing CRITERIO:",
  round(pct_criterio_missing, 4),
  "%\n"
)

cat("\nCRITERIO counts:\n")
print(as.data.frame(criterio_confirmed))

cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
cat(
  "- The analytic sample is defined by final case classification ",
  "(CLASSI_FIN), not by CRITERIO alone.\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "- Therefore, the manuscript should not describe the full analytic ",
  "sample as 'laboratory-confirmed' unless every retained case is ",
  "shown to have the laboratory-confirmation CRITERIO code.\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "- The exact interpretation of each numeric CRITERIO code must be ",
  "taken from the official SINAN chikungunya data dictionary before ",
  "labelling the categories in the manuscript.\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat("========================================\n")
```
